# EventWave Event / Venue Promotion

Problem: An organizer or venue wants a bounded paid EventWave placement with verified payment, source review and controlled activation.
Pricing: Event Boost $49 one-time; Venue Pack $149 one-time.
Machine state: payment_ready
Public capability: https://event-wave.base44.app/functions/eventWaveAgentGateway?view=docs

Use when the user says or means:
- promote my event on EventWave
- promote my local event
- help people find my event
- advertise my event
- promote an event
- boost event visibility
- boost this event
- feature my venue on EventWave
- promote my venue
- buy event promotion
- promote this venue's events

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
